remaining_open_items: Digitize and validate the exact2position MSTBA mating derating curve before claiming current capacity vs ambient.
Pin1 remains library convention without assignedpositive/negative net.
The sourced1.3mohm plug value does not establish a separate3mohmclamp+3mohmmating series split.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Rating-critical mating derating/thermal context and validated contact-path model unresolved. Resolution: The Phoenix-hosted header PDF https://www.phoenixcontact.com/us/products/1757242/pdf (archived manual download c2d4094a..., generated 2026-10-06) and the primary plug page (archived bb59d2fa...) close it to a stated-value level. Contact path: header R1 = R2 = 1.4 mohm (p4, IEC 60512-9-1 durability test, 25 cycles) and plug R1 1.3 / R2 1.4 mohm; recipe uses one lumped 1.4 mohm path per position (DERIVED max, confidence M) with no assumed clamp+mating split, so no ASSUMPTION value enters. Mating derating: p11 contains the exact pair curve 'Type: MSTB 2,5/...-ST-5,08 with MSTBA 2,5/...-G-5,08' (1 = 2-pos.); digitized by eye to 12 A up to about 84 C (L confidence) and recorded as a rating context, not a model input; recipe is op-only and isothermal. Operating ambient -40..100 C is primary-sourced. Runtime check validates the compiled path against the stated value. CORRECTION: existing header_working_voltage_II_2 = 400 V (and the D035/conflict text 'pair limited by 400 V header') comes from the 2013 Conrad copy; the current Phoenix PDF and product page give II/2 630 V for 1757242, and III/3 320 V (header) vs 250 V (plug). Existing OHM-161 working_voltage_III_3 250 V cites only Conrad; the primary plug page supports 250 V for the plug.
Whether 1.4 mohm includes the screw clamp; no guaranteed maximum published.
